notes:
Context: mid-market product analytics vendor (B2B SaaS). Started on Redwood Hosted API to speed prototyping (chat-based support bot + semantic search). Usage pattern: many short chat sessions (avg 1k tokens/session), high embedding throughput for nightly reindexing. Observed Hosted token costs spike during peak batch jobs — primary driver to move to Dedicated for predictable unit economics and VPC isolation.

POC summary:
- Scope: 4-week POC to validate latency, cost, and routing. Testbed: mixed workload (chat gen + embeddings + rerank).
- Infra: Redwood provided test pool approximating 2x A100; SE tuned batching and KV cache.
- Perf targets: p50 < 100ms for simple chat turns, 95th < 180ms accepted. Current POC numbers: p50 ~82ms, p95 ~140ms for generation; embedding throughput meets nightly window.
- Load profile: sustained 10-12 qps for support chat, bursts up to 75 qps for releases; nightly embedding batch ~200k embeddings over 2 hours.

Commercial ask / Negotiation points:
- Commit levels: prefer a 6-month initial commit with 3-month ramp (start at 50% of committed QPS, ramp to 100% by month 4). Want month-to-month visibility and one-time ramp credits if early usage exceeds commit during marketing window.
- Burst: requesting 20% free burst headroom on top of committed capacity for short windows (<=2 hours/day). Above that, propose capped overage billing at 1.5x list rate up to 50% overage, then tiered pricing beyond.
- Overage: prefer soft cap and notification thresholds (50%, 80%, 100% of commit) plus auto-fallback to Hosted API if Dedicated saturated.
- SLAs: asking for 99th pctile latency SLA for dedicated pool; Redwood to provide traceable per-route metrics and per-token cost breakdown.
- Billing: prefer monthly billing against committed spend with reconciliation credits for early ramp overspend. Interested in annual pre-pay discount if commit >= $250k ARR.

Security / compliance: legal requires data residency addendum (customer-controlled keys for logs/metrics), SOC2 letter plus confirmation of audit logging retention settings. PII filter for support transcripts is required.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need cost certainty for our CX roadmap — spikes during launches are killing margins." — Head of Product
- "If Redwood can give predictable burst rules and a simple overage cap we'll move faster." — VP Engineering

Open items:
- Legal to review Redwood data residency addendum (asked for redlines).
- Finalize commit level (6-month vs 12-month) and agree ramp credits.
- Confirm VPC peering window and runbook for failover to Hosted API.
